To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the filipin-treated isolated rat-liver cell system can be used as a tool to investigate the kinetic characteristics of enzymes in their native environment in situ.

filipin can be used to make isolated rat-liver-cell plasma membranes permeable to sucros and other low-mol. wt. compounds, and that the leakage of lactade dehydrogenase can be prevented by including glutathion and ATP in the medium.

the permeability of isolated rat liver cells to small molecules can be increased by treatment of the cells with filipin and that this increase in permeability can be used to investigate the kinetic properties of enzymes in their native environment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a technique that will permit the isolation of intact cells from tissues and the study of the metabolic pathways in these cells under in vitro conditions.
the development of a new approach for the investigation of the kinetic parameters of intracellular enzymes in their macromo...
the characterization of isolated rat-live cells made permeable by the antibiotic filipin.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
filipin can be used as a tool for studying the permeability of the plasma membrane of isolated cells.
the use of filipin to make cells permeable for small molecules is a useful tool for the study of the metabolic function of cells.
the filipin-treated liver cell system is a useful tool to study the kinetic characteristics of enzymes in their natural environment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the permeabilization with filipin can be used for studying the kinetics of enzymes in their natural macromolecular environment.
filipin is a very useful tool in studying the structure and the function of the membrane.

filipin can be used to permeabilize cells to small molecules, but that this treatment has to be performed with great care, because the cells may be damaged by the treatment and/or the leakage of lactase dehydrogenase may be too fast to allow for the performance of kinetic measurements.
The main takeaway from our work is that
filipin can be used to prepare permeabilized cells for studying the kinetic parameters of intracellular enzymes.
filipin treatment of cells can be used as a model to study the kinetic properties of enzymes in their native environment.
the filipin-treated isolated liver cells are a good model to study the metabolic regulation of the glycolytic enzymes.
